answer: Like a desert dune shaped by shifting winds, decentralized consensus anchors identity in deep, interlinked trust graphs. Legitimate peers intertwine like an ancient vine, accumulating verifiable interaction weight, while an ephemeral Sybil agent flashes and dies like a transient comet. Proof of transitive stake enforces superlinear attacker cost: forging multiple synthetic identities demands polynomial bond growth, suffocating counterfeit swarms under mounting capital debt.
